issues.explanation: The standard prints the term as «اقدام مقابله با مخاطره (ریسک)» (with the ریسک qualifier). The proposed preferred_fa strips the qualifier to «اقدام مقابله با مخاطره» and demotes the printed form to alternatives_fa. Rule 1 requires preferred_fa to equal what the standard prints at that clause.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «اقدام مقابله با مخاطره (ریسک)» exactly as printed; move «اقدام مقابله با مخاطره» (without qualifier) to alternatives_fa.

verdicts.key: big data business security risk control

issues.explanation: The definition_fa correctly presents and attributes two distinct definitions—one from INSO 23728 clause 3.1.16 (organizational/privacy meaning) and one from INSO 23685 clause 3-1-4 (security/big-data meaning). However, the editor_note_fa cites only «INSO 23728 بند 3.1.16» as the defining source, making no reference to INSO 23685. This creates a false impression that the entry is solely anchored in the privacy standard, obscuring the second authoritative source.
issues.suggested_fix: Extend editor_note_fa to read: «اصطلاح تعریف‌شده در INSO 23728 بند 3.1.16 (با معنای سازمانی/حریم‌خصوصی) و در INSO 23685 بند 3-1-4 (با معنای امنیتی/کلان‌داده)؛ بازبینی‌نشده.»
